name: mj359d-cos-window
goal: Fit the recorded oversized watchdog batch into the 80x24 CoS composer and deliver the next alert.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: 8b9716 confirmed the recorded 3100-character prompt scrolls the 80x24 composer, hiding its prompt marker and preventing Enter.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing tmux fixtures do not reproduce composer overflow. Replay the recorded queue through the authentic watchdog port and a fixture that hides the prompt for oversized drafts.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The committed 80x24 fixture accepts the paste into the scrolled draft, then records zero Enter presses. The unchanged regression requires one.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Bound the complete message, including receipt references, to 720 bytes. Render oversized rows as item references and a short sentence, and include only slot detail that fits.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The same frozen test command failed at d4548a51ce without Enter, then passed at a53d022680. The bounded prompt included all eight pointers and a ninth alert was delivered in the next round.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
